import numpy as np

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors=set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    markers=[v for v in colors if v not in (0,2,8)]
    # ARC background/noise is the nonzero color shared outside marker; template is all cells of unique marker color.
    if not markers: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    mark=markers[0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==mark]
    minr=min(r for r,c in pts); minc=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in pts}
    oh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; ow=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-oh+1):
      for c in range(w-ow+1):
        if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
          for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=mark
    return out
for label,src,dst in [('d1',demo_in,demo_out)]:
  got=transform([list(map(int,x.split())) for x in src.splitlines()]); expected=[list(map(int,x.split())) for x in dst.splitlines()]
  print(label,got==expected, sum(got[r][c]!=expected[r][c] for r in range(len(got)) for c in range(len(got[0]))))
